result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, but a loading spinner is stuck over an already-rendered restaurant image in the 'Popular right now' section, obscuring the dish photo.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is overlaid in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image even though the photo behind it is fully rendered, making the card look like it is still loading and hiding part of the dish.
issues.suggestion: Dismiss the loading indicator once the image has loaded, and only show the spinner while the image is actually pending so the dish photo is fully visible.
